name: tapos-qa-automation
description: Automated validation of TaPoS/JACRO products and interconnected workflows.

scripts.plan:a-readonly: tsx config/run-plan.ts A-readonly && cross-env QA_SUITE=A-readonly playwright test --list
scripts.plan:a-gated: tsx config/run-plan.ts A-gated && cross-env QA_SUITE=A-gated playwright test --list
scripts.plan:b: tsx config/run-plan.ts B && cross-env QA_SUITE=B playwright test --list
scripts.plan:c: tsx config/run-plan.ts C && cross-env QA_SUITE=C playwright test --list
